clare.finance: Heads-up: Nimbus Health put INV-2026-1127 on hold. They say platform fee line appears twice on their private deployment invoice. Can someone check metering?

noah.revops: Pulling the metering export now. Any recent contract activity for Nimbus?

leo.am: They migrated to a new private contract and bumped support on 2026-04-05. SEs agreed to a 6-day validation window (complimentary). Could be overlap.

clare.finance: Invoice excerpt pasted:
- INV-2026-1127 line 2 PLATFORM-NIM-01 $10,800
- INV-2026-1127 line 3 PLATFORM-NIM-01 $10,800 (duplicate?)
- INV-2026-1127 line 4 SUPPORT-PREM-NIM $2,700

tara.billing: Metering export uploaded: /billing/exports/2026-04/nimbus_20260410.csv by metering-bot at 2026-04-10T09:15Z

metering-bot: [system] export ready

tara.billing: I scanned the CSV. Two active commits overlap: commit_old (2025-05-01 -> 2026-04-30) and commit_new (2026-04-05 -> 2027-04-04). Both emitted prorated PLATFORM_FEE for the overlap window 2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-30.

noah.revops: Sounds like the migration job created the new SKU but didn't retire the legacy platform_fee SKU. I'll open an engineering ticket and add a test to prevent duplicate platform_fee SKUs for the same customer-day.

eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4410 created by noah.revops: "migration tool not retiring legacy platform_fee on contract wrap - Nimbus duplicate platform_fee"

leo.am: Customer notes: 6-day complimentary validation 2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-10. Procurement is holding payment until corrected. Need credit memo + corrected invoice ASAP.

clare.finance: Tara, please compute prorates and prepare credit memo. Noah, can you include a quick scan for other recent migrations?

tara.billing: Platform fee annual $10,800 -> daily $29.5890. Overlap duplicate period 26 days -> $769.31. Complimentary 6 days -> $177.53. Support proration: premium $2,700 annual -> daily $7.3973; we billed full year but should pro-rate from 2026-04-06 -> credit 1 day = $7.40. Total credit = $954.24. Draft CREDIT-2026-0501 and corrected INV-2026-1127A uploaded to /billing/credits and /billing/invoices/drafts.

leo.am: Forwarding SE sign-off for comp days to billing. Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll pay after portal shows corrected invoice."

clare.finance: Approved. Tara please apply credit and push corrected invoice to portal, add account note referencing ENG-4410. Noah please run the migration scan and report back in tomorrow's sync.

noah.revops: Will run scan now and schedule patch to retire legacy SKUs during migration; canary for 48h.

metering-bot: [system] Invoice update: INV-2026-1127 -> INV-2026-1127A issued 2026-04-11T17:05Z

clare.finance: Thanks team. Close loop once portal shows payment released.
